verdict.rationale: Stripe documents stablecoin settlement rails explicitly: Machine Payments/MPP and x402 support USDC/USDC.e minimums as low as 0.01 across Tempo, Solana, and Base, with a documented HTTP 402 challenge-response flow, deposit addresses, PaymentIntent recording, and conformance tooling (mppx validate). This is concretely documented and distinct from card rails. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond Stripe docs, and clarity on stablecoin settlement across all US states (NY excluded) plus more detail on failure/refund handling for stablecoin-specific flows.
